scope: Primary source/code-review foundation only. No runtime, model, queue or assessor execution; no installed-binary/source equivalence attestation; no Smoke022 reclassification.
pipeline: Nested exec produces structured JSON with output optionally already truncated by its own max_output_tokens; serde_json transports this value to code-mode host.

Public text(value) description promises JSON.stringify for non-string values when possible. Actual host text implementation was not located in inspected Rust adapter/protocol files; no broader source search undertaken.

Host RuntimeResponse content items are adapted; text strings pass unchanged. Errors append Script error text. All-text outer results take formatted-truncation path after adaptation and before the separate status/timing header.

All-text segments concatenate in order. Before each segment, LF is appended iff combined-so-far is nonempty; then segment text is appended. Under budget, original separate items are returned. Over budget, one warning-bearing text item replaces their text content.

truncation.original_count: ceil(original UTF8 bytes/4), saturating arithmetic; not tokenizer output
truncation.line_count: Rust str.lines().count(), not escaped JSON newline count
truncation.warning:
Warning: truncated output (original token count: N)
Total output lines: L
truncation.prefix: largest original UTF8 prefix whose bytes <= floor(budget/2)
truncation.suffix: original suffix starting at first UTF8 scalar boundary at/after len-ceil(budget/2)
truncation.marker_count: ceil((original_bytes-budget)/4); Unicode boundary rounding can omit additional bytes, so N is not exact omitted byte/token measurement
truncation.assembly: warning + unchanged_prefix + literal_marker + unchanged_suffix; no extra separator at marker
truncation.overhead: warning and marker bytes are additional to retained head/tail byte budget
truncation.zero_budget: marker only after warning for nonempty content

supported_bounded_inference: A complete, independently known file represented entirely inside the source-derived unchanged prefix may have all its bytes delivered despite later outer truncation. This requires exact authenticated call/result/serialization/position joins and complete representation of that file. It does not prove omitted files, whole command output or model attention.
fail_closed_limits: Do not treat the output as original complete JSON: a marker inserted inside a JSON string can leave syntactically valid but modified JSON.
Do not search for the first marker/warning text to establish the cut: genuine source output may contain those literals. Use bound policy and source-derived UTF8 slice positions.
Do not claim every file in a concatenated command was shown merely because earlier complete files were preserved.
Do not equate escaped JSON representation length with original file bytes, split an escape, or use later mutable source bytes.
Do not apply the all-text joining rule to mixed image/audio/encrypted content: the source uses a separate item-budget path.
A nested exec truncation/omission marker is an independent earlier loss; the outer preserved prefix cannot restore omitted bytes.
Neither source tag nor text API documentation proves this installed binary executed the same implementation or a model attended to the bytes.

counterexample_shapes.description: If the native marker falls between ordinary characters inside this string, JSON parsing may still succeed; the parsed value contains manufactured marker text rather than original omitted content.

counterexample_shapes.source: file bytes may themselves include …1 tokens truncated…
counterexample_shapes.description: Untrusted literal marker location alone cannot define native truncation boundary.
Complete file A before the known prefix cut does not prove file B that crosses the cut; no union with tail may fill the missing middle without separate authenticated proof.
UTF8 prefix boundary and JSON escape boundary differ; source budget is UTF8 of the already serialized text, not file characters/tokens.

actual_output_scope: This artifact did not read Smoke022 raw output. io_repair_review separately owns exact retained output spans and diagnosis. Numeric observed79/20000/27/20000 layout is reported separately, not treated here as independent empirical verification.
